title: Federated learning oriented chain-crossing consensus method and system
assignee: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

pse.problem: Central server-based collaborative learning architecture faces challenges such as termination upon coordination server crash, privacy leakage due to malicious coordination server, model poisoning by malicious parties, and lack of incentive mechanism.
pse.solution_function: Blockchain-based Federated Learning (BFL) provides a decentralized control system that ensures continuous updates to the machine learning models through smart contracts.
pse.solution_structure: The solution includes a model training module for machine learning model update and aggregation, and a smart contract module for decentralized control using blockchain technology.
pse.solution_implementation: Smart contracts are used to manage keys and provide control functions, ensuring the federated learning system continues even if a node crashes.
pse.effect: BFL addresses the central server challenges by providing an immutable, decentralized, and incentivized collaborative learning framework.

knowledge_graph: Immutable, decentralized, and incentivized collaborative learning framework
